recent_excerpts: A Radiant Security webinar examines why WAF, DLP, OT/IoT, dark web, and supply chain alerts are routinely ignored by SOC teams — and how automation can close the gap.
Analysis of 25 million security alerts across enterprise environments shows defenders systematically ignore low-severity events, missing an average of one genuine threat per week.
Rapid7's 2026 Global Cybersecurity Summit agenda shifts focus from threat volume to earlier detection, exposure management, and AI-assisted decision-making across two tracks.
